lines.text: While going up to Jerusalem, Jesus took the twelve disciples aside and said the Son of Man would be delivered to the chief priests and scribes.
Jesus said the Son of Man would be delivered to the Gentiles to be mocked, flogged and crucified, and raised on the third day.
The mother of Zebedee's sons knelt before Jesus and asked that one son sit at His right and the other at His left.
Jesus asked if the brothers could drink His cup, they answered "We can," and the ten were pleased with them.
Jesus said whoever wants to be great must be a servant, since the Son of Man came to rule and give His life as a ransom.
